title: गुरुङ – नेपाली शैक्षणिक शब्दकोश Gurung-Nepali Shaishyanik Shabdakosh
nepali: गुरुङ – नेपाली शैक्षणिक शब्दकोशको नमुना प्रस्तुत गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार गरिएको यो लेख लमजुङ र कास्की जिल्लामा प्रयोग गरिने गुरुङ भाषामा आधारित छ । यसमा प्राथमिक र द्वितीयक दुबै स्रोतबाट तथ्यहरू सङ्कलन गरिएको थियो । प्राथमिक तथ्य सङ्कलनका लागि लमजुङ र कास्की जिल्लाबाट १५–१५ जनाका दरले जम्मा ३० जना गुरुङ मातृभाषी वक्ताहरू उद्देश्यमूलक तरिकाबाट छनोट गरियो । निर्धारित गुरुङ मातृभाषी सूचकहरूसँग प्रत्यक्ष सम्पर्क गरेर तयार गरिएका विभिन्न विषय क्षेत्रसँग सम्बन्धित नेपाली भाषाका आधारभूत शब्दसूची अनुवाद गर्न लगाई प्राथमिक तथ्यहरू सङ्कलन गरियो भने गुरुङ भाषामा प्रकाशित पाठ्य सामग्री, कोश, व्याकरण जस्ता सामग्रीका आधारमा द्वितीयक तथ्यहरू सङ्कलन गरियो । यसरी सङ्कलन गरिएका तथ्यहरूलाई कोश सम्पादनको सैद्धान्तिक आधारमा गुरुङ–नेपाली शैक्षणिक कोशको नमुना प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । यस लेखमा १९० गुरुङ भाषाका आधारभूत शब्दहरूका आधारमा गुरुङ – नेपाली शैक्षणिक शब्दकोशको नमुना दिइएको छ । यसमा गुरुङ भाषामा प्रविष्टि दिएर तिनको शब्द वर्गीय सूचना, नेपालीमा समानार्थी एवम् गुरुङ र नेपाली भषामा प्रयोग समेत दिइएको छ । कोशको नमुना देवनागरी लिपिमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english: Prepared with the objective of presenting a model of a Gurung–Nepali pedagogical dictionary, this article is based on the Gurung language used in Lamjung and Kaski districts. In it, data were collected from both primary and secondary sources. For primary data collection, a total of 30 native Gurung speakers were selected in a purposive manner at the rate of 15 individuals each from Lamjung and Kaski districts. Primary data were collected by directly contacting the designated native Gurung informants and having them translate basic word lists in the Nepali language related to various subject areas, whereas secondary data were collected on the basis of materials such as textbooks, dictionaries, and grammars published in the Gurung language. On the theoretical basis of dictionary editing, a model of the Gurung–Nepali pedagogical dictionary is presented using the data collected in this manner. In this article, a model of the Gurung–Nepali pedagogical dictionary is provided on the basis of 190 basic words of the Gurung language. In it, headwords are provided in the Gurung language along with their word-class information, synonyms in Nepali, and usage examples in both the Gurung and Nepali languages. The model of the dictionary is presented in the Devanagari script.

informal_english: Prepared with the objective to present a sample Gurung–Nepali pedagogical dictionary, this article is based on the Gurung language used in Lamjung and Kaski districts. In this, facts and figures were collected from both primary and secondary sources. For primary data collection, totally 30 Gurung mother-tongue speakers were purposively selected taking 15 persons each from Lamjung and Kaski districts. Primary data were collected by making direct contact with the designated Gurung mother-tongue informants and getting them to translate basic Nepali word lists related to various subject areas, while secondary data were collected on the basis of materials like textbooks, dictionaries and grammars published in the Gurung language. Based on the theoretical foundation of dictionary editing, a sample of the Gurung–Nepali pedagogical dictionary is presented using the data collected in this manner. In this article, a sample of the Gurung–Nepali pedagogical dictionary is given taking 190 basic words of the Gurung language. In this, entries are given in the Gurung language along with their word-class information, Nepali synonyms, and usage examples in both Gurung and Nepali languages. The sample dictionary is presented in the Devanagari script itself.
translator_notes: The source contains a minor typo 'भषामा' for 'भाषामा' (in language). The eight-sentence structure, sample counts (30 speakers, 15 each, 190 words), and linguistic terminology are strictly preserved across all variants.
